title: Claude Code Global User Configuration
description: Global user configuration/state file for Claude Code CLI. Current builds prefer ~/.claude/.config.json and fall back to legacy ~/.claude.json. This schema models the persisted global file (auth state, UI preferences, caches, usage counters, IDs, and nested per-project state) and intentionally excludes separately merged settings.json/project/policy configuration.
$comment: Reverse-engineered from cli.unpack.js v2.1.92 using DEFAULT_GLOBAL_CONFIG (Lr() at line 188868), GLOBAL_CONFIG_KEYS (Gtq at line 189636), PROJECT_CONFIG_KEYS (vtq at line 189637), project defaults (xn6 at line 189624), and notification/editor/theme enum tables.
